## All at sea

**Word Power 31 · English idioms**

### Meaning

Confused or uncertain.

### Usage

1. I'm all at sea with these new instructions.
2. Most of the students are at sea in English.

### Your turn

Use “all at sea” in a sentence of your own. The original lesson image also includes Hindi support and illustrations.
